items.q: How does ShopFinder get better prices?
items.a: We aggregate offers from manufacturers, authorized distributors and marketplaces (eBay, AliExpress, Amazon, Newegg, DigiKey) into a single catalog. When you buy, the order is automatically forwarded to the supplier with the best price — you pay once and the rest is invisible.

items.q: What currency are prices shown in?
items.a: Prices are shown in BRL with an hourly-updated USD-BRL rate, so the value reflects the current exchange rate with no checkout surprises.

Each specification can carry its source (manufacturer, datasheet, distributor or marketplace) and a confidence level. Attributes with traced origin and evidence have high confidence; AI estimates show lower confidence and go through review.
The catalog keeps a graph of relations (e.g.: CPU and motherboard with the same socket). On the product page you can see what is compatible before buying, avoiding parts that do not work together.

sections.title: 5. Data sharing
body: END ART Studios does not sell personal data. Sharing will occur only when necessary, proportionate and compatible with the stated purposes.

Suppliers will receive only the data necessary for the offer, order, delivery, warranty, cancellation and support. Providers and suppliers must maintain confidentiality, security, cooperation with data subject rights and incident reporting.

sections.title: 6. International transfers
body: Some providers may process data outside Brazil, including in the United States or other countries, according to the infrastructure actually contracted. International transfers will only occur where there is a legal hypothesis and a valid mechanism under the LGPD and ANPD regulation.

Mechanisms may include an adequacy decision, standard contractual clauses, equivalent clauses, specific clauses, global corporate rules or another applicable legal hypothesis. END ART Studios keeps a record of the recipient, country or region, purpose, data categories, recipient's role, sub-processors, adopted mechanism and safeguards.

Providers that may be involved include Stripe, Vercel, Neon, the AI provider, e-mail, support and security. The identification of the entity, country, role and mechanism must reflect the contracts in force. Sectoral certifications, including PCI-DSS, are considered security measures and do not, by themselves, constitute a legal basis for international transfers.

END ART Studios applies minimization, purpose restriction, retention controls, confidentiality and security. Personal data will not be used to train third-party models without a legal basis, transparency and appropriate controls.

sections.title: 7. Cookies, localStorage and sessionStorage
body: ShopFinder uses cookies and local or session storage technologies for authentication, security, cart, comparison, language, currency, temporary exchange rate, images, notifications and preferences. The updated list, classification, duration, providers and management options are in the Cookie Policy (/cookies).

Storage strictly necessary for the requested feature, authentication, security or communication transmission may be used without consent where allowed by law. Optional preferences, analytics, advertising, unnecessary personalization and tracking depend on the applicable legal basis and consent where required.
Where there is consent, the data subject may accept, reject and manage categories with equivalent options and may change or revoke their choice through the preferences panel.

sections.title: 8. Retention and deletion
body: Data will be kept for the time necessary for the purpose, the contractual relationship, security, handling of rights and legal obligations.
After the period ends, data will be deleted, anonymized or blocked, except where retention is required by legal obligation, fraud, audit, regular exercise of rights or another legal hypothesis.

sections.title: 9. Security
body: END ART Studios adopts technical and administrative measures proportionate to the risk, including credential protection, encryption in transit where applicable, access control by need, audit records, backups, vulnerability management, environment segregation, provider management and training.

No transmission or storage is absolutely secure. Data subjects must keep their credentials confidential, use a protected device and report suspected unauthorized access via the official e-mail. END ART Studios will never request full passwords by e-mail.

sections.title: 10. Security incidents
body: END ART Studios maintains a procedure to identify, contain, investigate, remediate and document incidents. Suppliers and operators must promptly report any relevant event and cooperate with the investigation.

Where the incident may cause relevant risk or damage to data subjects, END ART Studios will notify the ANPD and affected data subjects within the period and in the form set out in the LGPD and current regulation, including ANPD Resolution No. 15/2024. The notice will state, where applicable, the nature of the data, data subjects involved, risks, protection measures and mitigation actions.

sections.title: 11. Artificial intelligence and automated decisions
body: ShopFinder may use automated rules, statistical models and artificial intelligence to organize the catalog, summarize specifications, identify compatibility, order results, recommend products, detect abuse and improve security.

Outputs may contain errors, omissions or outdated information. Recommendations, Authority and Coverage scores, compatibility and classifications do not constitute certification, quality guarantee, authenticity, safety, provenance or professional advice.

END ART Studios does not use AI to decide alone on credit, civil rights or the data subject's essential access. Where automated processing affects the data subject's interests, they may request information about criteria and procedures and human review, subject to legitimate trade and industrial secrets.

Personal data sent to AI providers will be minimized, pseudonymized or deleted where possible. It will not be used to train third-party models without a legal basis, transparency and appropriate controls.

sections.title: 12. Data subject rights
body: Under the LGPD, the data subject may request confirmation of the existence of processing, access, correction, anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary or unlawfully processed data, portability subject to regulation, deletion of consent-based data where applicable, information about sharing, information about the possibility of not providing consent, revocation of consent, objection where applicable, review of automated decisions and other rights provided by law.

Requests must be sent to endart.studios@gmail.com. Proportionate proof of identity may be requested to prevent fraud. END ART Studios will respond within the applicable statutory and regulatory periods and may explain, in a reasoned manner, limitations arising from legal obligation, security, third-party rights or trade secrets.
Data subjects may also resort to the ANPD, consumer protection bodies or the courts, without prejudice to their rights.

sections.title: 13. Children and adolescents
body: ShopFinder has a catalog accessible to the public but is not directed at children. Account creation, contracting and data processing must observe legal capacity, best interest, applicable law and age-appropriate protection measures.

END ART Studios does not intentionally request children's data for purposes incompatible with the LGPD. If improper collection is identified, it will take reasonable measures to verify the occurrence, protect or delete the data and contact a guardian where appropriate.

sections.title: 14. Links and third-party services
sections.body: ShopFinder may contain links to or integrations with suppliers, manufacturers, marketplaces, payment processors and other websites. Upon leaving ShopFinder, processing follows the third party's policies and terms. A link does not mean control, warranty, authenticity, sponsorship or endorsement by END ART Studios.

sections.title: 15. Changes to this Policy
body: This Policy may be updated to reflect legal, technical, operational or security changes. The current version and the update date will be made available on this page.

Material changes will be communicated by appropriate means and, where required, will depend on new consent. The update will not retroactively reduce rights related to processing already carried out nor modify completed orders.

sections.title: 16. Governing law and contact
body: This Policy will be interpreted according to applicable Brazilian law, especially the LGPD, the Brazilian Internet Civil Framework, the Consumer Defense Code and ANPD rules. Non-waivable rights of data subjects and consumers will prevail over any incompatible provision.

END ART Studios is identified by the following data: trade name END ART Studios — CNPJ 45.370.930/0001-75, informed location Osasco, São Paulo — Brazil, contact endart.studios@gmail.com, website https://shop-finder-taupe.vercel.app/.

sections.title: 1. What cookies and local storage are
body: Cookies are small files or identifiers stored in the browser or device. They can keep session, preferences, cart, security and other information between visits.

localStorage and sessionStorage are browser storage mechanisms. Although they do not work exactly like cookies, they can allow scripts to store and read information on the device. For that reason, ShopFinder describes them in this Policy and classifies them according to their purpose.

The fact that a technology is not automatically sent to the server does not, by itself, mean it is outside the scope of transparency or data protection. The classification considers purpose, necessity and the possibility of association with the user or device.

sections.title: 2. Categories used
body: Essential: necessary for authentication, security, fraud prevention, technical operation or making a user-requested feature available. Without them, certain functions may not work.

Preferences: allow remembering choices such as language, currency, compared items, notifications or other settings. They can be disabled, although this may require setting them again on future visits.
Analytics and measurement: measure usage and performance to produce statistics or improve the platform. They will not be activated without the applicable legal basis and consent where required.

Advertising and tracking: used for behavioral advertising, cross-site tracking or advertising profiles. ShopFinder does not use this category in the currently declared configuration. Should it start to, it will update this Policy and request prior consent where necessary.

sections.title: 4. Third-party cookies
body: ShopFinder may use providers for hosting, authentication, payment, security, database, e-mail, observability or artificial intelligence. A technical integration may create or read the provider's own identifiers, even if they do not appear in the list above.

Before activating any non-essential third-party technology, END ART Studios must register name, domain, provider, purpose, duration, data categories, country, consent mechanism and revocation option. Payment, authentication and security providers may operate technologies strictly necessary to the requested service, according to the current architecture and applicable law.

END ART Studios does not use third-party advertising, analytics or behavioral tracking cookies in the currently declared configuration. If that configuration changes, this Policy and the consent mechanism will be updated before activation.

sections.title: 5. Consent and preference management
body: Strictly necessary technologies may be activated without consent where permitted by law. Preference, analytics, advertising or tracking technologies will be activated according to the applicable legal basis and, where necessary, only after a positive manifestation by the user.
ShopFinder does not consider the mere continuation of browsing as valid consent for optional purposes. The user must find equivalent options to accept, reject and manage non-essential categories.

The user may change or revoke their choices through the "Cookie Preferences" link, available in the footer or in a permanently accessible location. Revocation does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before it, but will stop the optional technologies as soon as technically possible.

Refusing non-essential cookies will not prevent access to functions that do not depend on them. ShopFinder may keep essential technologies necessary for security, authentication, the requested cart or compliance with a legal obligation.

sections.title: 6. How to control technologies in the browser
body: The user can also clear or block cookies and local storage in the browser settings. Blocking essential technologies may prevent login, cart, comparison, security or other features.
Clearing storage does not necessarily revoke consent records kept securely to evidence a previous choice. To change the consent choice, use ShopFinder's "Cookie Preferences" panel.

sections.title: 7. Relationship with the Privacy Policy
body: Cookies and storage may contain identifiers or information associable to a natural person. Where that happens, processing will also follow the Privacy Policy (/privacidade), including purposes, legal bases, sharing, international transfers, security, retention and data subject rights.
The data subject may request confirmation, access, correction, deletion, objection, revocation or other measures via endart.studios@gmail.com, in accordance with the LGPD and applicable law.

sections.title: 8. Updates
body: This Policy may be updated when there is a change of technology, provider, purpose, duration, category, legal basis or legislation. The current version and the update date are available on this page.
Changes that introduce non-essential technologies will be communicated and submitted to consent where necessary before activation.

scores.authorityDef: Authority (0–100) measures how trustworthy the origin of each piece of catalog information is.
scores.authorityFactors: Policy default-authority-v1 — weighted average of 4 factors: source type (40% — manufacturer 100, datasheet 95, distributor 80, retailer 70, marketplace 60), evidence confidence (30%), freshness (15% — decays over 30 days) and connector quality (15% — official API 100, mirror 80, scraper 70, partner 60).
scores.priceAuthority: Price and stock carry low authority as a manufacturer statement (10 and 5 out of 100): that data comes from supplier offers, not from the manufacturer.
scores.coverageDef: Coverage (0–100) measures how complete each manufacturer's data is in the catalog, per product segment.
scores.tiers: Manufacturers are grouped into tiers by Authority: A ≥ 98, B 92–97, C 82–91, D < 82.
scores.sourcesLine: Sources: our own catalog and integrated suppliers — manufacturer profiles, offers and evidence with URL and collection date.
scores.updatedLine: Indicators are updated along with the catalog; each product page shows "Updated at" with the data timestamp.
scores.aiLine: Where AI comes in: specification normalization, data enrichment and compatible-product matching via the knowledge graph. Outputs may contain errors and do not replace verification by the user or the supplier.
scores.limitations: Limitations: the indicators may contain errors; they are not a certification, quality guarantee, manufacturer endorsement or official recommendation.
scores.notSponsored: Unsponsored ranking: no payment, advertising or paid placement affects the score.
scores.contest: Want to contest information or a score? Reach us via /contato or endart.studios@gmail.com.
